milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining yellow concrete powder drops the item directly into the player's inventory. The player starts with no yellow_concrete_powder in their inventory, and the only source is the placed 3×3 wall at z+5 from spawn. Concrete powder always drops itself when mined (no silk touch or special tool required), and the player will be adjacent to the block when it breaks, guaranteeing auto-pickup. This is the preferred rule type for mine/obtain tasks per the milestone design guidelines.
